blocks.text: A short note on where the commercial due diligence stands. Cynthia Hart has the market and competitive reading substantially in hand for the two segments that matter most, and Nicole Griffin has assembled the public filings and the trade sources sitting behind it, so the base of evidence is coming together as we planned. None of it is a conclusion yet; it is the ground the later commercial judgment will rest on.

To close the picture I need two things from your side. The first is the internal customer and revenue detail we flagged in our opening request, so that the public record can be checked against your own numbers rather than left to stand on its own. The second is thirty minutes each with two of your commercial managers, since the texture behind the revenue tends to live with the people who carry the accounts. If any of that needs a sign-off above your desk, Barbara Banks, point me to the right person and I will approach them directly rather than add to your own load.

Send whatever is easiest straight to me, Melissa Casey, and I will keep this thread as the single place these requests and their answers live. If the customer detail reaches us by the middle of next week, we stay comfortably on track for {{fact:f:E-2015-001.client}}.
